top_signals.title: India's 97 GW Coal Expansion Plan Looks Too Small, Senior Official Says
top_signals.summary: India may need to revise up its planned new coal-fired capacity installations through 2035 amid soaring electricity demand that needs grid stability and flexibility, a senior Indian official said on Tuesday. Last year, India planned to raise its coal-fired power capacity by a total of 97 gigawatts (GW) until 2035, and have 307 GW of coal capacity installed.
